annotation.title_clean: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法
annotation.title_en: Interim Measures for the Administration of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家互联网信息办公室 (Cyberspace Administration of China) with NDRC, MoE, MoST, MIIT, MPS, NRTA
annotation.summary_en: China's Interim Measures for generative AI services (Order No. 15, effective 15 Aug 2023) regulate public-facing text, image, audio and video generation services. They set content, anti-discrimination, training data, labelling, personal information, complaint and security assessment duties, and balance innovation with prudent, tiered supervision.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to generative AI services offered to the public in mainland China; R&D without public service is exempt
Providers must use lawfully sourced data and models, respect IP, and obtain consent for personal information
Generated images and videos must be labelled per deep synthesis rules
Services with public opinion or social mobilisation capacity need security assessment and algorithm filing
Inclusive, prudent, tiered supervision; penalties under existing cyber, data and personal information laws
